description: Design branded diagram images for social posts — layer diagrams, flows, loops, quote + stat cards, sequence diagrams, numbered steps — as hand-authored HTML rendered to PNG, styled from the business's own brand settings pulled from the Marky API. Use this when a post announces, teaches, or compares something and a designed diagram would beat a stock photo: "make a diagram for this post", "turn these steps into an image", "make an infographic". A companion to plan-social-content and schedule-posts: it produces the image; those skills attach and schedule it.
